audienceUsers.description: DERIVED by LaunchPad from the dashboard's owner and user shares; never written by a client. The bare user ids the read rule matches with $contains, so the dashboard's discussion is open exactly to those who may view the dashboard (openregister-leaf-integrations).

audienceGroups.description: DERIVED by LaunchPad from the dashboard's group shares, or the group of a group dashboard. The bare group ids the read rule matches with $contains against the caller's groups.

audienceEveryone.description: DERIVED by LaunchPad: true for the default group dashboard, which every signed-in user may view.
